description:
WHAT: Detect PII (emails, phones, US SSNs, Luhn-valid cards, mod-97 IBANs, UK NINOs, India Aadhaar/PAN/GSTIN, Korea RRNs, Japan My Number, Singapore NRIC/FIN, Vietnam CCCD, Taiwan national IDs, China resident IDs, IPv4/IPv6) and secrets (AWS/GitHub/GitLab/Slack/Stripe/Google/OpenAI/Anthropic/HF/npm/SendGrid/Twilio/Azure keys, JWTs, private keys, URL credentials, key=value secrets) in text.
WHEN: Before sending prompts, tickets, logs or files to an LLM or third party; to audit text for leaked credentials. Findings are paged across all documents.
WHEN NOT: To get sanitized text use pii_redact_text. For person names/addresses (NER), public URLs or PDFs use pii_guard_documents (paid). Not for images (no OCR).
COST: Free. Local regex/validators only; no APIFY_TOKEN.
RETURNS: Paged findings across all documents, each with a masked preview; raw values are never returned. Errors: INPUT_TOO_LARGE.
BEHAVIOR: No network calls; text never leaves your machine; milliseconds.
PARAMETERS: texts: one array element per document; each finding carries doc_index = the element's 0-based position, and the 500,000-char cap applies to the SUM of all elements (over it -> INPUT_TOO_LARGE; split into several calls). entityTypes: filters findings after detection; names are case-insensitive, unknown names silently match nothing, and NER-only types (PERSON, LOCATION, STREET_ADDRESS) never match here. allowList: compared with the whole matched value, case-insensitively (allow "support@yourco.com", not "yourco.com"). entropyScan: only adds HIGH_ENTROPY_STRING findings; it never removes others. defaultPhoneRegion: affects only national-format numbers such as "030 1234567" (needs "DE"); "+49 ..." numbers parse with any region. limit/offset page the flat findings list across all documents, while meta.documents always summarises every document; fetch the next page with offset = nextOffset until hasMore is false.
EXAMPLE: {"texts":["Mail jane@acme.com, key AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"]} -> 2 findings: EMAIL (masked "j***@a***.com"), AWS_ACCESS_KEY; risk_level "critical".

allowList.description: Optional, default [] (nothing exempt). 0-500 exact values (<= 500 chars each) that are never flagged; whole-value, case-insensitive match, not substring. Example: ["support@yourco.com","192.0.2.1"]

defaultPhoneRegion.description: Optional, default "US". ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (2 letters, pattern ^[A-Za-z]{2}$, case-insensitive) used only for phone numbers written without a +country prefix. Examples: "US", "DE", "GB"

entityTypes.description: Optional, default omitted = every local detector. 0-40 detector type names (<= 40 chars, case-insensitive), e.g. ["EMAIL","CREDIT_CARD","AWS_ACCESS_KEY"]. Valid values: the "type" field of pii_list_detectors rows with local:true; unknown names match nothing (no error)

entropyScan.description: Optional boolean, default false. true also flags unlabeled random-looking tokens of 20-200 chars as HIGH_ENTROPY_STRING (catches unknown key formats; may flag hashes/UUIDs). Example: true

limit.description: Optional page size: items to return, integer 1-1000 (default 100). Example: 50

offset.description: Optional zero-based number of items to skip, integer 0-1000000 (default 0); pass nextOffset from the previous response, e.g. 100

texts.description: Required. 1-50 documents (prompt, chat message, log, file content), each <= 200,000 chars, total <= 500,000 chars. Example: ["Mail jane@acme.com, key AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"]

name: pii_scan_text

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

title: Scan text for PII and secrets locally (free)
